info.description: Per-page crawler and unfurl metadata. Required on every page rather than optional, because an optional SEO component is an empty SEO component: the title and description are what a server-rendered page exists to emit, and a page that ships without them renders a blank social card forever. Deliberately has no raw-JSON structured-data field — arbitrary JSON-LD is the same hole through the taxonomy that raw HTML is (PROVE-OUT P22), and meaningful schema.org markup comes from typed content, not from a textarea.
